periods.time: vol-16 ch-003, end of Nene vs Naseem

name.zh: 宁音以翻天覆地放逐纳西姆
name.en: Nene banishes Naseem with Hanten Fukuchi

periods.summary: While her oni Overdrive is crushing Naseem, Nene remembers her first defeat by Kurono and realizes that Naseem cannot replace that rivalry. Raw violence does not truly provoke or inspire her; only Kurono does. Nene voluntarily breaks her horns, returns to human form, re-summons one damaged fan, and faces Naseem despite being far weaker. Naseem, shaken by the fear she already carved into him, charges recklessly. Nene lightens his gravity to ruin his balance and taps his side with Benibotan. The touch does not hurt his body; instead it loosens a Calabi-Yau spatial node in the one-dimensional space his existence occupies. The universe's own correction pulls the opened dimensions back into a compact point, dragging Naseem out of normal four-dimensional space. Naseem panics and begs to be killed, but Nene cannot stop the phenomenon and pushes him fully into the point.
periods.cause: Nene rejects surrendering to monstrous Overdrive because she wants to surpass Kurono as someone worthy of admiration, so she must win by human will and technique.
periods.outcome: Naseem disappears from the battlefield; Nene wins but collapses from accumulated damage and cannot continue to fight Or-Gaule.
periods.significance: Concludes Nene's arc by showing that her true strength is not becoming a monster like Naseem but using rivalry, ingenuity and self-restraint to exceed him.
